text: dsh-command-delete 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的项目与会话管理插件，通过主机端命令注册和侧边栏页脚的管理面板提供删除入口。用户可以查看项目和会话列表，按 ID 删除工作区登记，或删除已保存的会话记录；命令行方式支持 /delete-project、/delete-workspace 和 /delete-session。删除项目只移除 DSH 中的登记，保留目录与会话日志；会话删除会清理持久化记录，并拒绝删除仍打开的会话。界面操作提供确认对话框。安装需在插件目录运行 DSH 插件添加命令，并依赖 DSH 的工作区注册表、会话持久化与 Web 服务。

dsh-command-delete adds project and session management to DSH Web. Slash commands and a sidebar panel list items, remove workspace registrations, and delete saved session records. Project removal preserves files and logs; session deletion refuses open sessions. The panel asks for confirmation.
想从 DSH 里移除一个不再使用的项目登记，但保留本地目录。
怎么清理已经保存的 DSH 会话记录？
我想在侧边栏里查看项目和会话，再选择要删除的条目。
dsh-command-delete 的功能「工作区登记删除」：用 /delete-project 或 /delete-workspace 输入 ID，可移除 DSH 项目登记并保留目录和会话日志；不带 ID 会列出项目。
dsh-command-delete 的功能「持久化会话删除」：在 Web 管理面板确认删除，或运行 /delete-session 并提供会话 ID；插件移除保存的会话目录，并拒绝删除仍处于打开状态的会话。
dsh-command-delete 的维护与更新元数据：低活跃；距最后推送 86 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 47/100（置信度 low）。
dsh-command-delete README · dsh-command-delete：DSH commands for removing a project registration and deleting a persisted session.

dsh-command-delete README · Web UI：The Web bundle adds a trash icon in the sidebar footer. It opens a management panel with project and session lists. Every destructive action has a confirmation dialog.

Project deletion removes only the DSH workspace registration; the directory and session logs remain. Session deletion permanently removes the persisted session log and refuses live/open sessions.

dsh-command-delete README · Commands：```text
/delete-project <workspaceId>
/delete-workspace <workspaceId>
/delete-session <sessionId>
```

`/delete-workspace` is an alias for `/delete-project`.

Project deletion uses DSH's workspace registry. It removes only the DSH project/workspace registration. The project directory and all session logs remain on disk.

dsh-command-delete README · Commands：Session deletion removes the persisted JSONL session directory. It refuses to remove a session that is still owned by a live Agent. The current DSH release does not expose a public session-delete lifecycle, so live/open sessions are intentionally not deleted by this plugin.

dsh-command-delete README · Install from this checkout：From the directory that contains this package:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile default add .
```

Use the profile name you normally run with instead of `default` when needed. Restart DSH after installing the bundle.

With no id, each command prints the available IDs:

```text
/delete-project
/delete-session
```
